reason: I like that it has no sugar and no sweeteners, and the label is cleaner than my Monster Ultra. But I buy energy drinks on the road at petrol stations, and this is only online or in some cafés I never go to, so in a normal week I'd never actually come across it.
objection: I can't just grab it when I need it. I'm not ordering cans online and waiting for delivery, and I'm not going to a bistro for a can of mate.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the fridge at the petrol stations I stop at (Shell, OMV, Orlen) next to Red Bull, at about the same price.
